title: Blue Marlin
meta_description: Welcome to Blue Marlin! Gulf-front 2BR condo with pool, private balcony \& beach service---near Rosemary Beach, perfect for sunsets \& family fun!
description_expanded:
Gulf-front views, easy beach days, and classic West End relaxation come together at Blue Marlin, a beautifully located condo in Ramsgate Harbour next to Carillon Beach. Set along one of Panama City Beach's quieter stretches, this 2-bedroom retreat gives you front-row access to the emerald coast, with panoramic Gulf views from the private balcony and a laid-back setting made for families, couples, and beach lovers.

Inside, the living area is designed for easy downtime after the sand and sun. A comfortable sleeper sofa and two sitting chairs face a large flat-screen TV, creating a relaxed spot for movie nights, game days, or cooling off between beach outings. Just beyond, the private Gulf-front balcony invites you to slow down with morning coffee, sunset drinks, or simply the sound of the waves in the background.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for casual meals at home, from cookware and dishes to plenty of prep space for snacks, breakfasts, and beach-day lunches. The dining table seats four, with additional bar seating at the kitchen counter for extra flexibility.

Sleeping arrangements are well-suited for families or small groups. The primary bedroom features a king bed, ensuite bathroom, Gulf views, and direct access to the private balcony. The second bedroom includes two twin beds and its own ensuite bathroom, while a queen sleeper sofa in the living room provides additional sleeping space. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience throughout your stay.

The communal amenities make Blue Marlin especially easy to enjoy. Ramsgate Harbour offers a 550-foot private beach, a community pool heated seasonally, covered parking, and a community clubhouse that can be reserved through the HOA office. Guests also receive two beach chairs and an umbrella each day from March through October, weather permitting. For added fun, beach chairs, kayaks, paddleboards, and beach bonfires are available through Surf n Sun, with seasonal beach bonfire invitations included with your booking.

When you're ready to explore, Blue Marlin places you in the West End of Panama City Beach, just minutes from Rosemary Beach and close to coastal dining, shopping, fishing, snorkeling, parasailing, and more. Whether you're spending the day under an umbrella, strolling the shoreline, or heading out on the water, this Gulf-front condo makes it easy to enjoy the best of the beach.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This unit comes with 2 parking spots and guest must registered and pay the HOA directly for parking pass. $35 per pass. Upon booking, we'll send an email link to register and pay for parking pass.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
